description: Defines the LoadBalancerEncoder class and related interfaces for encoding QUIC load balancer connection IDs, including configuration management and routing information encoding.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoder
classes.description: Manages QUIC load balancer configurations to encode server IDs into connection IDs, supporting configuration updates, deletion, and connection ID generation.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about load balancer configuration changes (add, change, delete).

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new LoadBalancerEncoder instance with no active config, given random source, visitor, encoding mode, and unroutable ID length.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Replaces current load balancer configuration and server ID if valid; returns success status.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes current configuration, switching to unroutable connection IDs.

methods.name: GenerateConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a new connection ID based on current config or unroutable ID if no config.

methods.name: GenerateNextConnectionId
methods.description: Generates the next connection ID based on an original ID, as part of ConnectionIdGeneratorInterface.

methods.name: MaybeReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Attempts to replace a connection ID based on current config and version, as part of ConnectionIdGeneratorInterface.

methods.name: ConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Returns the length of connection IDs based on the first byte, as part of ConnectionIdGeneratorInterface.
